kjv: Even [the same] that I (Jesus) said unto you from the beginning
mine: Why do I (Jesus) even speak to You at all?
note: ten archen ho ti kai lalo hymin is notoriously obscure; "ten archen" used adverbially means "at all", making a question or exclamation. The KJV's "from the beginning" is a possible but strained reading.

kjv: going through the midst of them, and so passed by
note: TR adds a phrase from Lk 4:30; absent from P66, P75, Sinaiticus*, B, D, W.
